label: nustack's org space built from an empty page: a page that talks, a movie club, a spend chart, our GitHub synced by a job, our brand, and an agent whose answer stays live.

chapters.title: Start from nothing
chapters.note: An empty space. One click, an empty page.

chapters.title: Write a page
chapters.note: Plain markdown. The page says what comes next.

chapters.title: Make a movie club
chapters.note: A few lines. Every film gets its own page.

chapters.title: Open its page
chapters.note: The film's own page. A note, then a tick.

chapters.title: Track the spend
chapters.note: A form and a chart over one list, live.

chapters.title: Change the code
chapters.note: Every block is code. One word, a new chart.

chapters.title: Sync the repos
chapters.note: A job pulls our GitHub. Commits land live.

chapters.title: Ask an agent
chapters.note: It reads the space while we keep going.

chapters.title: Look under the hood
chapters.note: The sync job in its own process, the agent beside it.

chapters.title: Bring in the brand
chapters.note: Our colors as a block. One pick, every board follows.

chapters.title: Read its take
chapters.note: Its answer is a cell on the page, not a chat log.

chapters.title: Add one more
chapters.note: One new spend. The agent's number follows.

chapters.title: Back home
chapters.note: Every box ticked. Home knows it all.
